titel: Why You Shouldn't Stop Your Bunny Eating Its Poop

beats.say: Why should you never stop your bunny... from eating its own *poop?*
Rudi catches his bunny doing it. And he totally *panics.*
So he sweeps up every dropping. The bunny just eats them straight from its *bottom.*
So Rudi gives it a giant *cone.* Now the bunny can't reach. And it's starving.
Those aren't normal droppings. They're soft *night droppings,* like tiny grapes.
Rabbits digest their food *twice.* Gut bacteria fill round two with vitamins.
Those little grapes are almost one third *protein.*
Without them, a bunny can become *malnourished.*
Just let it happen. But if you keep finding soft clusters on the floor, give more *hay,* and ask a vet.
So next time your bunny snacks from behind... ask yourself:
